Detailed Explanation: binary 00000000. Since bit position 0 is cleared, the expected output is 0. This confirms that the function correctly identifies a cleared bit at position 0.
binary 00000001. Since bit position 0 is set, the expected output is 1. This confirms that the function correctly identifies a set bit at position 0.
binary 11111110. The least significant bit (bit 0) is cleared, so the expected output is 0. This tests the function's ability to correctly extract bit 0 when other bits are set but bit 0 is cleared.
binary 11111111. All bits including bit 0 are set, so the expected output is 1. This confirms the function correctly extracts bit 0 when all bits are set.
